description: This file defines a data migration object for transitioning user preferences data from list-based storage to map-based storage within an Android app's data store. It implements the DataMigration interface, contains migration logic, and provides a method to check if migration is needed.

classes.name: ListToMapMigration
classes.description: An internal object implementing DataMigration to perform specific data migration logic from list to map within user preferences.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Completes any cleanup after migration; here it is a no-op.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration by transforming various user preferences fields from lists to maps.

methods.name: shouldMigrate
methods.description: Determines if migration is necessary based on current data state.
